markets.name: Papua New Guinea
markets.summary: The Investment Promotion Authority provides investor information, business introductions and registration resources. Begin with its official services when researching agriculture, fisheries, tourism or a local operating business.

markets.name: Fiji
markets.summary: Investment Fiji introduces tourism, commercial agriculture and renewable energy among its investment sectors. Its resources offer an official starting point for market research and investor enquiries.

markets.name: Vanuatu
markets.summary: Vanuatu’s investment agency introduces tourism, primary production and processing opportunities. Its sector information provides a starting point for checking business eligibility and discussing operating requirements.

markets.name: Samoa
markets.summary: Samoa’s Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour publishes investment resources covering tourism, agriculture, ICT and renewable energy. Its investment unit supports enquiries about registration and industry development.

markets.name: Solomon Islands
markets.summary: Invest Solomons introduces tourism infrastructure, fisheries, agribusiness, manufacturing and energy. The foreign investment division provides market information and investor services for establishment and expansion.

markets.name: Tonga
markets.summary: Tonga’s official investment portal introduces tourism, fisheries and agroprocessing. Its investor services explain foreign investment certification, business establishment and routes to local business contacts.
